'''Klaggus Purgato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was rumored to have been one of the main design techs of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-series combat prototype]].<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> According to [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Andor Javin]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|142|Javin, Andor}}</ref> he survived the [[Holowan Massacre]] and went into hiding, believing that the IGs were intentionally programmed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] their designers by an outside agency, most likely the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, an individual known as [[Pog]] was skeptical of Javin's claims and pointed out that it was never proven that Purgato was alive or even a [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]] designer.<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Klaggus Purgato was first mentioned in ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', a [[1997]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sourcebook cowritten by [[Drew Campbell]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />
